notes: The jobs page embeds filterConfig.filterGroups (department, location, level) and apiEndpoint /en/api/v1/jobs. GET /en/api/v1/jobs?from=0&size=16&department=trading returned totalCount=24 versus 153 unfiltered, confirming department is a server-side query parameter; location and level use the same filter-group ids. The page sets showSearch=false, so there is no keyword control.
